rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to introduce the point that matters most.

example.english: The thing that matters most is, importantly, that you like it yourself.
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 nei5 zi6 gei2 zung1 ji3

rows.note: Use this straightforward equivalent when explicitly highlighting the most important point.

example.english: The most important point is, importantly, that you arrive on time tomorrow.
example.jyutping: zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 hai6 ting1 jat6 zeon2 si4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when saying “what is important is ...” without necessarily ranking it as the most important point.

example.english: What is important is, importantly, that everyone is safe.
example.jyutping: zung6 jiu3 ge3 hai6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 on1 cyun4

rows.note: Use this for an emphasis marker meaning “the key point is ...,” rather than for importance in every context.

example.english: The key point is, importantly, that we do not have time now.
example.traditional: 重點係我哋而家冇時間。
example.jyutping: zung6 dim2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 mou5 si4 gaan3
